scorer.score_view: score_view(big, scope, gold_case) -> dict (pure; view(big, scope) scored against one gold case)
scorer.run_benchmark: run_benchmark(cases, {case id: {run label: big payload}}, scope) -> report (legs + micro aggregate per case kind)

gold_builders.gold_from_supplement: paper-kind gold from one case of a gold-supplement file (gold_v2_supported_reactions.json or paper_gold output)
gold_builders.gold_from_pathbank: full-kind gold from a pathbank_gold.extract payload (no I/O)
gold_builders.build_full_gold: extract by PW accession (the only database read in the module; extractor injectable) then gold_from_pathbank

reused_not_rebuilt: bench/eval_v2/reactions.match_reaction (reaction match by defining participants, reversible gold may match backwards)
bench/eval_v2/matcher (strict name key, parenthetical rule, enzyme_keys with complex components)

paper.purpose: Main benchmark. How well does the software extract what the paper itself says? Scored on view(big, PAPER_ONLY) only.
paper.why_this_gold: It is already paper-scoped: each case's scope field names the part of the pathway the paper states, every reaction carries a verbatim quote verified against the pinned full text, and a human certifies supported_reactions_complete per case. Reactions the paper states but that belong elsewhere are kept in off_pathway_reactions / summary_statements and are never gold. A paper that covers part of a pathway therefore has gold for that part only (the PMC12312563 case is exactly one step, MenD).

cases.why: Certified complete. Scope: the DHB arm and the assembly arm as the paper lays them out. Most stored runs of any gold paper (29).
Certified complete. Scope: the seven DHNA-forming steps (MenF to MenI) plus MenA and MenG. 2 stored runs.

Certified complete. A partial-coverage paper: the gold is exactly the one step the paper states, which is the 'part of the TCA cycle' rule of VISION section 4. 3 stored runs. One reaction, so report its numbers but never headline them.
supported_reactions_complete is false (not certified), so report.evaluate skips it. Recall is reported, precision is None. No stored run in the run list.

candidates_not_scored.why_not: Hinted draft, supported_reactions_complete false (ORCH-747), 1 reaction and 15 interactions; the paper is a 1981 scan and no run of it exists (the cohort used PMC11983282 for the Ara operon). The interactions in it are the only paper-scoped interaction gold in the repo: use them as a recall-only check once a human certifies the file.

not_paper_scoped.why: 10 cases of pathway anchors, expected enzymes, substrates and products, forbidden organisms. It is a core/context relevance set (expected_export, mechanistic_relevance), not a list of what the paper states; its supported_reactions are a 3-row subset. Not used as paper gold.

full.purpose: Small set. How much of everything known about the pathway did the software recover? Scored on view(big, FULL) against the whole curated PathBank pathway.
full.gold: build_full_gold(PW id): every reaction, transport, interaction, enzyme and compartment of the curated pathway, read through pathbank_gold.extract (accession resolved via super_pathway_visualizations.pw_id, never pathways.id). Identifiers (HMDB, KEGG, ChEBI, PubChem, DrugBank, UniProt of complex members) are kept for the id bridge.

cases.pathway: Ara operon inactivation, autoregulation of AraC
cases.note: extract committed, so the gold needs no database
3 stored runs, no extracted reaction in any (the paper is signalling)
same paper as PW488575: not independent
same paper as PW495535: not independent; no stored run of its own (the one run is the WNT PCP topic)

full.selection_rule: 3 to 6 pathways whose curated record is in PathBank and whose paper has stored runs. These five come from the ORCH-751 cohort table. The PathBank ids of the enterobactin and menaquinone papers are not recorded in the repository (open question), so the two certified-gold papers are in the paper set only.

per_type.gold: gold elements of the type (paper set: gold elements flagged in_paper false are dropped under PAPER_ONLY)
per_type.recalled: gold elements matched by at least one predicted element of the view
per_type.recall: recalled / gold; None when the case has no gold of that type (not zero)
per_type.predicted: deduplicated elements of the type in the scored view (reactions by the eval_v2 row key, transports and interactions by payload signature, enzymes by strict name key, compartments by row)
per_type.correct: predicted elements matching at least one gold element
per_type.precision: correct / predicted, reported only when the case declares the type complete; None otherwise

matching.reactions: eval_v2 match_reaction: every defining participant of one gold side on one predicted side, currency and cofactors excluded; reversible gold may match backwards. Identifier bridge: a predicted participant whose grounded ids (chebi, kegg, hmdb, pubchem, drugbank, uniprot; HMDB zero-padding folded) meet a gold term's ids is credited as that term.
matching.enzymes: gold enzyme term (name, aliases, complex members' gene names, member UniProt ids) against enzyme names of predicted reactions and transporters of predicted transports, with complex components expanded (eval_v2 enzyme_keys) or an id match
matching.transports: predicted cargo hits any gold cargo term; compartments agree unless both sides are known and differ (small spelling table: cytosol = cytoplasm, extracellular space = extracellular region ...)
matching.interactions: unordered entity pair, each side hitting a gold term; relationship canonicalised to activation / inhibition / binding and compared only when both sides have one
matching.compartments: folded name through the same spelling table

metrics.paper_stated_off_scope: reactions only: predicted rows matching an off_pathway or summary statement the paper makes. They are not true positives and stay in the precision denominator (eval_v2 table 1); the count shows how much of the precision loss is paper-stated chemistry outside the case scope.

full_view_only.recalled_base_only: gold elements recalled by rows of the paper payload alone
full_view_only.recovered_by_extension: gold elements recalled only because of extension rows (recalled minus recalled_base_only)
full_view_only.extension: per type and overall: extension rows in the view, how many match a curated element, precision = matched / rows. An unmatched extension row is 'not in this curated pathway', not 'wrong': the metric is a lower bound on correctness.
full_view_only.provenance: per type, predicted elements and how many are correct, by provenance kind (paper, other_paper, database, inferred, curation, unclassified). 'primary' puts each element in its highest-ranked kind in that order and so partitions the predicted elements (sums equal predicted and correct); 'any' counts an element under every kind it carries.

denominators.recall: gold elements of the case (and run-independent)
denominators.precision: deduplicated predicted elements in the scored view, complete types only
denominators.aggregate: micro-average over legs (sum of numerators over sum of denominators), as eval_v2; precision pools only legs whose case declares the type complete; paper and full kinds are never pooled, and cases that share a paper (PW495535, PW488575) are not counted as independent evidence

rules: The paper set is scored only on view(big, PAPER_ONLY); the full set on view(big, FULL). DEFAULT is reported as a third column for both sets so that a change at the default scope shows up (with no extension DEFAULT == FULL == base).
Gold is never edited to fit a run. Only a human certifies supported_reactions_complete; the builder reads the flag, it never sets it.
Identical runs differ at temperature 0: score at least three stored runs per case, report every leg, and call a regression only when it repeats.
PathBank pathways are mutable (status NULL or unlocked): record content_sha256 of the extract with every score and re-extract before comparing across dates.

Reactions of the full set are matched against the whole curated pathway; a curated step the paper does not state is a miss of the paper payload that an extension row may recover, never a miss of the paper set.
The product contract outranks every number here; a benchmark gain bought with a contract violation is a regression.
Before the extension lands (V4, V8) every full-view number is the paper-payload baseline; the recovered_by_extension and extension-precision columns are 0 / None by construction.
open_questions: PathBank ids for the enterobactin (PMC12096016) and menaquinone (PMC12421875, PMC12312563, PMC12657337) pathways are not recorded in the repository; with them the full set would share papers with the certified paper set.
The ten lab pathway ids named in the brief are not listed in any committed eval or pinned document; only the five of the ORCH-751 cohort are.

Interaction, transport and compartment gold for the paper set does not exist in certified form (gold_v2 holds reactions only); until a human certifies the PMC319880 supplement or writes more, those types are recall-only or not evaluable there.
